[New]

🟣 **Trunkrs**: Track Trunkrs parcels in the **Netherlands** with the tracking number and your postal code — with the **same-day delivery window**, out for delivery, delivered and the full history.

🟠 **Dynalogic**: Follow Dynalogic deliveries in the **Netherlands and Belgium** with your order number and postal code — out for delivery, delivered, problems and returns, sender, receiver and history.

🟢 **Dragonfly / Intelcom**: Track Dragonfly parcels in the **Netherlands and Australia** and Intelcom parcels in **Canada** — with **delivery window**, out for delivery, delivered, history in your language and parcels you send yourself.

📮 **Mondial Relay**: Sign in with your Mondial Relay / InPost account (**France, Belgium, Netherlands, Spain, Portugal**) and see your **incoming and sent parcels** automatically. Your password never reaches Homey.

📦 **Amazon (experimental)**: Sign in on Amazon's own page and see the shipments of your orders from **17 Amazon stores** (NL, BE, DE, FR, GB, IE, ES, IT, SE, PL, US, CA, MX, BR, AU, JP, IN) — with **item, delivery carrier, expected delivery date**, out for delivery, ready for pickup and delivered.

⚡ **Flow cards for every new carrier**: triggers for **new parcel, status changed, tracking event, out for delivery, delivered, problem** (plus ready for pickup, sent parcels and delivery time changed where the carrier supports it), conditions and actions to **track, stop tracking** and **remove delivered parcels**.

🧩 **In the widgets**: Trunkrs, Dynalogic, Dragonfly / Intelcom, Mondial Relay and Amazon parcels show up in **MyParcel Pakketten** and **MyParcel Bezorging**.

🌍 **Fully translated into 13 languages**: English, Dutch, German, French, Italian, Swedish, Norwegian, Spanish, Danish, Russian, Polish, Korean and Arabic — every device, capability, setting, **Flow card and token**, pairing screen, widget, notification and error message.

📅 **Your own format**: Dates, times, weights and dimensions follow your language, widgets show **“2 hours ago”** style times with correct plurals, and Arabic screens run **right-to-left**.

[Fix]

🔘 **Sign-in button**: The **Open sign-in** button on the InPost and Post & DHL Germany pairing screens did nothing.

⏳ **Pairing progress**: The **“Checking…”** text on pairing screens never appeared.

✅ **UPS condition**: **Account connected** only worked when Homey was set to English.

🇳🇱 **PostNL login in Dutch**: Some PostNL login and repair screens were shown in English to Dutch users.

🔧 **Repair**: Repairing Budbee, FedEx, Royal Mail and UPS devices is more reliable.

[Improvement]

🗣️ **Event texts in your language**: Budbee and Trunkrs tracking events are shown in your own language.

📝 **Clear error messages**: Pairing, repair and warning messages are full sentences in your language instead of technical codes.

🔄 **Your Flows keep working**: Flow tokens keep their existing formats.

⏱️ **Smart polling**: New carriers are checked every **15 minutes** near a delivery, less often otherwise, quiet at night, and **delivered parcels are never fetched again**.

🌟 Enjoy the improved MyParcel v0.3.6 App with five new carriers, many more countries and the whole app in your own language.
